explanation: Generated one physically allowed ep -> e'peta EXCLURAD input at W=1.600 GeV, Q2=1.000 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.500, and phi*=90.000 deg. It uses the eta configuration's CLAS12 defaults: EtaMAID-2023 model selector 3, full O(alpha) corrections, 6.53 GeV electron beam, detected recoil proton, and vcut=0.166 GeV^2. No numerical radiative correction was computed because this workspace has no compiler or shell/executable runner. Run the eta EXCLURAD executable from a directory containing this file as input.dat and the required model table; read sigma_obs/sigma_Born from radcor.dat (the sixth numeric output field).
